summary.text: People named the fused white and black heaven fragments spectral heaven.

claims.text: White heaven and black heaven fragments in the fused two heavens melt and join together in blue fire, becoming one entity named spectral heaven. As the blue fire slowly extinguishes, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s body is left burning, and even the smallest spark on him is tens of feet tall; he becomes the greatest source of light there.
Later the previous black-white overturning clouds vanish completely.
After it has just formed, the heavenly wind qi wall is not thick enough and there are no clouds.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable emits a cold flame and slaughters lifeforms of the two heavens. Countless beast groups escape the fused two heavens and land in the five regions. Most are killed by the icy flame, and his body continues to expand. Some time later the flame covers both heavens. The three venerables and countless lifeforms of the five regions watch as the blue fire burns for two days and nights. White heaven and black heaven fragments in the fused two heavens melt and join together in that fire, becoming one entity. A new heaven appears.

With immemorial black heaven as the foundation and white heaven completely conquered and absorbed, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, who had devoured black heaven’s heavenly spirit, becomes the ruler of the new heaven. His body is colossal, on par with the previous sun. As the blue fire slowly extinguishes, only his body is left burning, and even the smallest spark on him is tens of feet tall. He becomes the greatest source of light there, emitting a cold killing intent at all times and spreading his aura to the five regions.

Fang Yuan did not see such a phenomenon in the five hundred years of his previous life. The Gu cultivation world’s environment is slowly changed: light path is suppressed while dark path is amplified. Conflicts and deaths arise all around the world. Most lifeforms, including Gu Masters, cannot avoid the immense killing intent. Soul beasts start to appear all over the world, and heaven’s will also stabilizes. In Eastern Sea, a rank five Gu Master named Hua Ben Ku looks at spectral heaven and the majestic figure at its center, then lowers her head; in that short time the killing intent in her heart accumulates to her limit.

After spectral heaven forms, it gradually stabilizes. The beast groups that escaped earlier return and live in the new heaven again. Grotto-heavens keep their doors tightly shut and condense into one spot; they survive with some losses. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable dominates spectral heaven but rarely moves. The two heavens’ grotto-heavens try not to open their doors and connect to the outside world, in case he might approach them.

The environment in spectral heaven changes. The previous black-white overturning clouds vanish completely, so Fairy Zi Wei can no longer use them while Duke Tong and other Heavenly Court immortals hunt her. During that hunt a pink beast-form dream realm, covered in an illusory halo, charges them. Fairy Zi Wei flies toward it and is swallowed in one mouthful together with Ying Wu Xie. Afterwards Duke Tong finds more dream realms. They have various forms but they are all beasts. He says dream realms have gathered into a group, and that this is a new transformation in spectral heaven. He watches the dream realm that swallowed Fairy Zi Wei and Ying Wu Xie mix into that group. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable receives his report separately. She names them heaven path dream realms and says their appearance is the ploy of heaven’s will.

Black heaven and white heaven are gone. Only spectral heaven remains, and it is Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s territory. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable wants Feng Jin Huang to go there in due time to explore the heaven path dream realms. Feng Jin Huang refuses, saying she is only a mortal and has no confidence in exploring dream realms of that level or in guaranteeing her own safety.

After making arrangements, Fang Yuan flies to the sky and enters spectral heaven, then goes toward the heaven path dream realms. Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven obtain the news quickly, and it spreads through the five regions’ Gu Immortal world. Spectral heaven has already become Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s territory. He does not show any movements when other Gu Immortals enter or leave, like a tiger occupying a mountain that ignores small animals. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable pay close attention with investigative killer moves as Fang Yuan, a venerable, enters. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable does not show any movement. Both venerables are shaken.

Once Fang Yuan has flown in, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable pays close attention to this place. When Fang Yuan fights Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, the environment in spectral heaven is not helpful to the three venerables. They rely on their own foundation and strength.
Spectral heaven has just formed. The heavenly wind qi wall is not thick enough, and there are no clouds, so the five regions’ Gu Immortals can observe the battle easily.

After leaving spectral heaven, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable goes into Central Continent and starts a massacre. His injuries are severe, but he can heal himself by slaughtering lifeforms and hunting soul beasts to increase his strength. He had done this in spectral heaven earlier.
